validation_rules: 172 records expected from four 40-item blocks plus one 12-item block
Every item must have 4-8 answer choices
Exactly one correct answer must map to an answer choice
Stem and explanation must be non-empty
Telegram/UI chrome must not leak into stem/explanation
Exhibit pages are preserved as source-page references for later image cropping
Interleaved linked-item pages are grouped by Question ID rather than page adjacency
answer_distribution_note: Percentages are preserved when displayed by the source. For these questions, the source result screen itself displayed Collecting Statistics, so percentages are unavailable and intentionally left null rather than fabricated.
final_validation_checks: unique question IDs and app IDs
4-8 labeled options and correct answer maps to an option
non-empty stem, explanation, correct answer text, educational objective
core UI/Telegram/result-state leakage absent from stem/explanation/objective
source Collecting Statistics cases left with null percentages rather than fabricated values
interleaved linked-vignette pages grouped by Question ID rather than page adjacency
final_polish: Page-local reconstruction applied to known overlap-corrupted explanations; obvious OCR joins/units normalized only where supported by the rendered source; visual-overlay OCR removed from stems while visual page refs were retained.
